page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c56g1.14xlarge is an accelerated compute instance belonging to the Compute Optimized with GPU family. Built on the KVM hypervisor and the x86_64 architecture, it is powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock of 2.9 GHz. The virtual machine provision provides 56 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 28 physical cores with two threads per core, backed by 48 MB of L3 cache and hardware support for AVX-512 with VNNI instructions. System memory comprises 346.0 GB of RAM, equivalent to approximately 6.18 GB per vCPU.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by a single dedicated NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU offering 24 GB of VRAM. The instance features no bundled local instance storage, requiring all persistent and scratch volumes to rely on network-attached block storage. Baseline network bandwidth is provisioned at 16 Gbps, while public IPv4 addresses are not included complimentary.

Benchmark results highlight strong computational and acceleration characteristics. The instance achieves top-tier results in language model inference, processing 2,464.01 prompt tokens per second and generating 89.85 text tokens per second on 7B parameter models, alongside 9,738.91 prompt tokens per second on smaller 135M models. CPU benchmarks indicate solid multi-core throughput, reflected in a PassMark CPU score of 51,481.37 and 262.06 GB/sec in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, while single-core execution remains in the mid-range tiers across stress-ng tests.

Cost efficiency is driven by the density of dedicated CPU cores and large system memory paired with a single mid-range accelerator. This profile suits tasks that require substantial host compute and memory without necessitating multi-GPU arrays. The architecture is appropriate for small-to-medium LLM inference, AI-assisted video transcode and rendering pipelines, accelerated data analysis, and relational database operations that benefit from high memory density and dedicated compute resources.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c56g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance featuring 56 dedicated vCPUs (28 physical cores) based on the 2.9 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor and 346.0 GB of system memory. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU equipped with 24 GB of VRAM. The instance delivers a baseline network throughput of 16 Gbps and does not include local storage, relying entirely on network-attached storage solutions. Benchmark measurements show top-decile performance in LLM inference for models up to 7B parameters, achieving 89.85 tokens per second in text generation, alongside top-quartile PassMark CPU and database operational scores. With 6.18 GB of RAM per vCPU, the server offers efficient resource density for enterprise workloads requiring strong multi-core processing combined with single-GPU acceleration, including machine learning inference, computer vision processing, video transcoding, and memory-intensive database applications.
